# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: historical sov egy successors — scripted effects.
# Generated by tools/historical_politics_1970/sov_egy_successors.py.
# SOV communist retirement is a handoff to the existing Cold War succession chain.
MDCW_HP_SOV_native_retirement = {
	if = {
		limit = { MDCW_HP_SOV_retirement_available = yes }
		set_country_flag = MDCW_HP_SOV_manual_retirement_pending
		COLDWAR_SOV_succession = yes
	}
}

MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_request = {
	clr_country_flag = MDCW_HP_SOV_manual_retirement_pending
}
MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_pending = {
	MDCW_HP_SOV_clear_manual_retirement_request = yes
	clr_country_flag = MDCW_HP_SOV_manual_retirement_choice_pending
}

MDCW_HP_sync_sov_egy_counter = {
	# SOV civilian eligibility uses MD's existing liberalism_leader counter; do not reset it.
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = EGY IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes check_variable = { MDCW_HP_native_retirement = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } has_country_leader = { name = "Zakaria Mohieddin" ruling_only = yes } }
			set_variable = { conservatism_leader = 0 }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } has_country_leader = { name = "Hosni Mubarak" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { conservatism_leader = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } has_country_leader = { name = "Gamal Abdel Nasser" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } OR = { has_country_leader = { name = "Anwar as-Sadat" ruling_only = yes } has_country_leader = { name = "Anwar Sadat" ruling_only = yes } } } set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } has_country_leader = { name = "Khaled Mohieddin" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 2 } }
	}
}

MDCW_HP_set_egy_manual_leader = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire } COLDWAR_EGY_set_party_leader_1970 = yes }
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { conservatism_leader = 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { conservatism_leader = 1 }
			create_country_leader = { 	name = "Hosni Mubarak" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/EGY/hosni_mubarak.dds" 	ideology = conservatism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { conservatism_leader = 1 } }
			set_variable = { conservatism_leader = 0 }
			create_country_leader = { 	name = "Zakaria Mohieddin" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/EGY/1970/zakaria_mohieddin.dds" 	ideology = conservatism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } check_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 0 } }
			set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 1 }
			create_country_leader = { 	name = "Anwar as-Sadat" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/EGY_anwar_sadat.dds" 	ideology = neutral_Social }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } check_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 1 } }
			set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 2 }
			create_country_leader = { 	name = "Khaled Mohieddin" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/EGY/1970/khaled_mohieddin.dds" 	ideology = neutral_Social }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } check_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 2 } }
			set_variable = { neutral_Social_leader = 0 }
			create_country_leader = { 	name = "Gamal Abdel Nasser" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/EGY_gamal_abdel_nasser.dds" 	ideology = neutral_Social }
		}
		else = { COLDWAR_EGY_set_party_leader_1970 = yes }
	}
}

# One reviewed civilian historical addition to MD's native liberalism counter.
MDCW_HP_set_sov_yeltsin = {
	add_to_variable = { liberalism_leader = 1 }
	hidden_effect = {
		kill_country_leader = yes
		create_country_leader = { 	name = "Boris Yeltsin" 	picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SOV_boris_yeltsin.dds" 	ideology = liberalism }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire } subtract_from_variable = { liberalism_leader = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { b = 1 }
}
